events.description: Something is taken down where it happened — abstract, typed by nothing yet
The artefact learns what it is — a shot, a motif, a note, a testimony; the vocabulary stays open, never an enum
Legible at last — the artefact can be read, though not yet told
The artefact is asked to travel into a wider telling — the threshold appears
A named person said yes at a named threshold, and was in the room to say it
Withheld for now, or never asked — both of them wait
Someone who was in the room said no — an answer, not a pause
The one who had to be asked has answered — the threshold is approached again, never around
A flag raised on any artefact below holds the work above it — restriction climbs where permission never does
The hold lifts — the finished work returns to the publication threshold intact
Cleared to be seen at this scale, by someone with the standing to say so
Another episode takes its number — the memory lengthens
Someone outside the work asks a question, or names a requirement they carry
The same question arrives again, from someone else — recurrence is the evidence; a single asking never was
An episode already held the answer — the question is met without a book, and that is a good outcome
A need has been shown rather than merely felt — now there is a reason for covers
The episodes ask to be seen, not only read — the chronicle turns toward a film
Chapters set and bound — the manuscript is finished, which is not the same as permitted
Scenes hang on the spine in story order
Rough cut complete with temp sound — ready to screen
Director/producers request editorial changes — back to the bench
Picture lock — no further editorial changes
Color grade approved shot by shot
Key, tempo, sections and chords set against picture — the music is ready to be mixed
Dialogue, music and effects mixed to final levels
Delivery master passes technical quality control — the machine is satisfied, which settles nothing relational
QC found a picture defect — regrade required
QC found an audio defect — remix required
QC found the score wrong against picture — rewrite required
The screening room is not enough — the work needs to be carried onto the land
What presence on the land taught returns as a new gathering, not as a note
Someone presses play — the work finds an audience
The listener moves on — the work advances, the story holds
A listener leaves the master line to author their own narrative — a new telling, at a new scale

states.name: Gathering
states.description: Wherever you are — a mobile surface open where the knowledge lives: voice, image, video, a MIDI take, a note. The device is incidental; being present is the point

transitions.description: Taken down on the spot — held before it is named

states.name: Artefact
states.description: The abstract type. It carries its provenance from birth — sources, authorityFlags, and a consent list whose honest emptiness says nothing has been permitted yet. What roots it, identity or duration or accountability, is a seam the Assembly left open on purpose; this machine does not close it

transitions.description: INTERNAL — the artefact acquires a kind and stays itself
INTERNAL — legible now, and still not told
A wider telling is asked for — and asking is not the same as being allowed

states.name: ConsentGate
states.description: Whose voice is in this? Do they consent to THIS telling, at THIS scale? A named person answers at a named threshold — nothing generated here may answer on their behalf

transitions.description: Yes, from someone who was in the room — the artefact may take a number
BRANCH — withheld for now, or never asked; both of them wait
BRANCH — a no that is an answer, not a delay

states.name: Held
states.description: Paused and routed to a named human — the work is not lost and not refused, it is waiting to be asked. Nothing ships while this holds

transitions.description: LOOP — the answer comes back to the threshold, never around it
LOOP — a hold raised at publication returns there, with the finished work intact

states.name: Withheld
states.description: Someone who was in the room said no. The telling ends here, and the record keeps the no rather than forgetting it

states.name: Chronicle
states.description: Episodic memory — each consented artefact takes its number and its place in the sequence. The chronicle lengthens on its own; it does not ripen into a book on its own

transitions.description: INTERNAL — the chronicle grows by one episode and stays itself
Someone outside carries a question the work might answer
BRANCH — the episodes ripen toward a film

states.name: CommunityInquiry
states.description: A question or requirement arrives from the community — the people who built alongside, who read, who are waiting. One asking is a conversation. The same question arriving again is a need, and a need is the only thing that earns a book

transitions.description: INTERNAL — the same question returns from someone else; the inquiry deepens and stays itself
BRANCH — the need is shown; there is now a reason for covers
LOOP — an episode already held the answer; no book is written, and nothing is lost

states.name: Manuscript
states.description: Episodes gathered into chapters against a question that would not go away — the chronicle takes the shape of a book because someone needed one

transitions.description: Bound and finished — now it must still be permitted

states.name: StorySpine
states.description: The thematic spine every rib attaches to and every fork branches from — scenes laid in story order

transitions.description: Spine holds — refine into a full cut

states.name: RoughCut
states.description: Full-length cut with temp sound and placeholder VFX

transitions.description: Cut screens for director and producers

states.name: Review
states.description: Director and producers screen the cut — verdict branches here

transitions.description: LOOP — notes go back to the spine
BRANCH — picture lock, finishing begins
The verdict is neither approve nor revise — the work goes to the land first

states.name: ColorGrade
states.description: Picture-locked footage graded shot by shot

transitions.description: Graded picture hands off to the songwriting bench

states.name: MusicalComposition
states.description: Music written to picture — key, capo, tempo, sections and chords; the same mobile surface as Gathering, used now for what it was named for

transitions.description: Cues written against picture — the score hands off to the mix stage

states.name: SoundMix
states.description: Dialogue, score and effects mixed against the graded picture

transitions.description: Final mix conforms into the delivery master

states.name: Master
states.description: Grade, score and mix conformed into the delivery master — the technical gate, and only the technical one

transitions.description: QC clean — the machine is satisfied; the circle has not been asked
BRANCH — picture defect routes back to the grade
BRANCH — a cue wrong against picture routes back to the songwriting bench
BRANCH — audio defect routes back to the mix

states.name: PublicationGate
states.description: The second threshold — not is it finished, but may it be seen. Book and film both arrive here, because a bound manuscript needs permission exactly as much as a graded master does

transitions.description: Cleared to be seen at this scale, by someone with the standing to say so
BRANCH — a flag on any artefact below holds the finished work above it

states.name: Released
states.description: Delivered, as book or as film — no longer an ending, but the door an audience walks in through

transitions.description: ENTRY — someone presses play and the traversal begins

states.name: Playback
states.description: The audience is inside the work — listening, reading, moving through it in time

transitions.description: INTERNAL — the work advances, the story holds its shape
The audience becomes the community — what they met leaves them with a question
FORK — the listener becomes an author, and a new telling meets the same threshold as any other

states.name: OnTheLand
states.description: The circle goes on the land — knowledge received through presence, place, and relations, not through the screen

transitions.description: LOOP — the land's teaching re-enters as a new gathering and earns its own artefact
